manifest.name: dsh-superagent
manifest.author: DeepSeek Harness Team <team@dsh.dev>
manifest.description: A proactive agent for one GitHub repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub and optionally Feishu, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

bundle.text:
# dsh-superagent bundle layer: inserts the plugins without configuration, and the agent presets its Sessions run under. The
# profile supplies the `dsh-superagent` entry's stateDir (see docs/006-deployment.md and examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml); the plugin
# refuses to start without stateDir.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-superagent
      name: dsh-superagent
    - id: dsh-superagent-github
      name: dsh-superagent/github-watch
    # Optional Feishu Source; requires configuring a bot CLI after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-feishu
      name: dsh-superagent/feishu-watch
      disabled: true
    # The agent preset of every Executor Session (WORKER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts); the main Session has its own, below.
    # It is DSH's `standard` preset with only what a worker needs, and a shell whose foreground command moves to a background job
    # after 5 seconds, so a long command does not hold back a person's message, which the Session takes at its next step. Left
    # out: questions to a person, presenting, plan mode, the plugin manager and market, scheduling, goals, workflows, web fetch,
    # and forked subagents, which would run under this preset; spawned subagents run under `standard`, whose shell moves a
    # command to a background job only after 60 seconds, as a subagent's jobs are killed when it ends. A preset row has no
    # setting that hides it from the preset picker, so its name and description say whom it is for.
    - id: dsh-superagent-worker-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-worker
        name: dsh-superagent 鎵ц鍣?
        description: dsh-superagent 鐨勬墽琛屽櫒 Session 涓撶敤锛屼笉渚涙墜鍔ㄩ€夋嫨銆傚墠鍙板懡浠よ秴 5 绉掕浆鍏ュ悗鍙帮紝鍙惈鎵ц宸ヤ綔鎵€闇€鐨勫伐鍏枫€?
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # A foreground command waits at most 5 s, then the shell tool moves it to a background job.
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: dsh-superagent/worker-shell-bash
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: dsh-superagent/worker-shell-pwsh
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # A wait for a job ends after 5 s too; the job's end wakes the worker with its result.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
                  agentPreset: standard
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
    # The agent preset of the main Session (ROUTER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts). The worker's 5-second shell and job waits, so a command or a wait does not hold back the next candidates, and
    # only what the main Session uses: no subagents, web, file search or writes, todo list, questions to a person, presenting,
    # plan mode, plugin manager, scheduling, goals or workflows. No persona: the main Session's prompt is complete, so it has
    # no other section.
    - id: dsh-superagent-router-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-router
        name: dsh-superagent 涓?Session
        description: dsh-superagent 鐨勪富 Session 涓撶敤锛屼笉渚涙墜鍔ㄩ€夋嫨銆傚墠鍙板懡浠ゅ拰浠诲姟绛夊緟瓒?5 绉掕浆鍏ュ悗鍙帮紝鍙惈璺敱鎵€闇€鐨勫伐鍏枫€?
        order: 91
        plugins:
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: dsh-superagent/worker-shell-bash
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: dsh-superagent/worker-shell-pwsh
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              write: false
              edit: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

readme.text:
> **非官方 · Unofficial.** 这是 [deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) 的 **Windows 移植参考实现**：把它改到能在 Windows 的 DeepSeek Harness 里加载运行，并把智能体身份从"整个 DSH 进程"缩小到"每一次命令"。不是 DeepSeek 官方发布物，也未获官方背书。
> A Windows port of DeepSeek Harness's research prototype `dsh-superagent`, with the agent identity scoped to each worker command instead of the whole DSH process.

---

`dsh-superagent` 是一个"主动式编码智能体"：监听 GitHub（可选飞书），把「某人请求做某件事」变成工单，在独立 DSH 会话里干活，干完回到原处交付（评论 / 分支 / PR），并带一个面板。

它以 **DSH bundle（插件包）** 形式工作：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <本包>`，加载后 DSH 侧栏多一个 **Superagent** 入口。

本仓库 = 上游源码 + 两类改动：

1. **Windows 兼容补丁** —— 上游原本只能在 POSIX 上启动；
2. **按命令下发身份** —— 把上游"改写整个进程环境"改为"只改写每次命令的环境"。

逐条差异见 [UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md)。上游设计文档仍保留在 [`docs/`](docs/)；`SETUP.md` 描述的是上游流程，Windows 上的实际步骤见下方"安装"。

---

上游 `applyEnvironment()` 改写 **DSH 进程**的 `PATH` 与 `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL`，因此要求跑在**专用 profile**（上游文档原话：*keep it separate from the profile you work in*）。

本移植把同样这些变量改为随**每次命令**下发（DSH 的 `ShellExecSpec.env` → `SubprocessSpawnSpec.env`）：

| | 上游 | 本移植 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| worker 的 `PATH` / git 配置 | agent 的 | agent 的（等价） |
| 同 profile 里**你自己**的会话 | `PATH` / git 配置被接管 | 不受影响 |
| 是否可并入日常 profile | 不建议 | 可以（`isolateEnvironment: true`） |

`isolateEnvironment` 是本移植新增的插件配置：`true`（默认）= 按命令下发；`false` = 完全不下发，worker 用宿主账号。

---

前置：DeepSeek Harness（`dsh` 0.2.1-rc 系列）、Node.js 22.19+/24+、pnpm、Git for Windows、GitHub CLI（`gh`，已 `auth login`）。

```powershell

git clone https://github.com/buyou-claw/dsh-superagent-win.git
cd dsh-superagent-win
pnpm install
pnpm build

readme.section: 2) 装进一个 profile（示例：新建 superagent profile）
readme.text:
dsh superagent --from-default-profile web --dump-config > $null
dsh plugin --profile superagent add "link:$PWD"
```

3) 写 `$DSH_HOME\profiles\superagent\cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: webserver
  config:
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: 3082
- id: dsh-superagent
  config:
    stateDir: C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\state\superagent   # 必填，绝对路径
    isolateEnvironment: true                        # 默认值；false = 不下发 agent 身份
```

readme.section: 2) 装进一个 profile（示例：新建 superagent profile）
readme.text:
4) 启动 `dsh --profile superagent`，打开日志里带 token 的 URL，侧栏选 **Superagent**：在「设置 → 来源」填仓库（`owner/name`）与 `gh` 路径，在「设置 → 策略」加允许派活的账号。

> 也可以并入**日常使用**的 profile：`dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add "link:$PWD"`，并在该 profile 的 patch 里加同一段 `dsh-superagent` 配置。`isolateEnvironment: true` 不影响你其他会话。

---

| 事项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `gh` / `lark-cli` 的 PATH shim | **不生成**。Windows 无法用无扩展名脚本遮蔽同名程序，worker 直接用 PATH 上的 `gh`；`blockedCommands` 仍生效（`.cmd` 存根）。 |
| `prepare` 命令 | 用 **PowerShell 语法**（`$env:DSH_SUPERAGENT_DIR` 等），不是 `sh`。 |
| worker 提交身份 | 隔离开启时 worker 的 git 带 `useConfigOnly = true`，提交必须显式给作者；提示词的 Delivery 段落已带 `DSH_SUPERAGENT_GITHUB_COMMIT_EMAIL`。 |
| 面板端口 | 与其它 DSH profile 分开（示例 3082）。 |

---

- 上游是研究原型；本移植只做"能在 Windows 跑 + 身份范围更小"，不改变其设计取舍。
- 仓库里的单元测试是 POSIX 形态（依赖 `sh`、`sleep`、`/tmp`），在 Windows 上会失败；交叉验证请在 WSL/Linux 里 `pnpm vitest run`。
- 移动端、多用户、远程部署未验证。

---
[UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md) 列出全部改动的位置与理由，便于上游更新后逐条 rebase，也便于把补丁提回上游。
